en.Win's VPN™ is built for censorship resis: Win's VPN™ is built for censorship resistance first: Winn Protocol® adapts between private adaptive secure routing, the infrastructure is monitored by 24/7/365 IDPS, the app uses Verified No Log privacy boundaries, and malicious-site filtering combines threat-intelligence sources. The goal is to keep the good parts users expect from major VPNs while focusing on low-cost access, anti-censorship reliability, and nonprofit-style mission continuity.
en.Winn Protocol® uses private adaptive sec: Winn Protocol® uses private adaptive secure routing. The goal is to keep the app simple for the customer while adapting to censorship, unstable networks, and Cloudflare-compatible routes behind the scenes.
en.Win's VPN™ is designed as Verified No Lo: Win's VPN™ is designed as Verified No Log for browsing and traffic activity: no browsing history, DNS query history, traffic contents, or destination activity logs. The service may store operational metadata such as account status, payment/referral records, device count for the three-device limit, security events, and legal acceptance evidence.
en.For speed issues, disconnect and reconne: For speed issues, disconnect and reconnect once, choose the nearest available server, keep battery optimization disabled for the app, and avoid metered or congested networks. Speedtest server suggestions can be wrong because geolocation databases differ; the useful test is actual browsing, download, and leak-test behavior after the VPN route is ready.
en.The Get Win's VPN section offers monthly: The Get Win's VPN section offers monthly, yearly, and lifetime options. PayPal subscription renewals and provisioning are intended to sync automatically with the control hub. Donation receipts and account emails are sent through the service email system when configured.
en.Paid users can share their referral link: Paid users can share their referral link from inside the app. When a referred customer signs up through that link, both sides can receive 20% more account validity. Free users can still share the public Win's VPN website, but free-only accounts do not receive paid-account validity bonuses.
en.Exclude Apps From VPN lets a user keep s: Exclude Apps From VPN lets a user keep selected apps outside the VPN tunnel. It is useful for banking, local network tools, or services that block VPNs. System apps are labeled so users understand what they are excluding.
en.Double VPN is planned to pass traffic th: Double VPN is planned to pass traffic through a physically controlled North America core server before the final VPN exit. Until that infrastructure is live, the app protects users by refusing to silently switch modes while connected and continuing with the normal Winn Protocol® route.
en.For the most stable tunnel, allow Win's: For the most stable tunnel, allow Win's VPN to ignore battery optimization when Android asks. The app also uses foreground-service and performance locks while connected, but some phone brands still require manually allowing unrestricted background battery use in system settings.
en.Win's VPN combines VPN tunneling with th: Win's VPN combines VPN tunneling with threat-intelligence filtering designed to block malicious domains, scam links, trackers, and risky destinations before they load. It is a protective layer, not a replacement for safe browsing habits or device security updates.

Privacy Policy and user data handling.
en.Win's VPN may access, collect, transmit,: Win's VPN may access, collect, transmit, or store only the user data needed for app and service functionality: account number, email address when provided for paid/manual accounts or support, app platform and version, device name/model, local split-tunneling package selections, device identifier bucket, source IP bucket, legal acceptance records, payment confirmation metadata received from PayPal, referral/account-validity metadata, support messages the user sends, security/abuse-prevention events, diagnostics or crash information when provided by the platform, and website analytics or ad-conversion events when consented to on the website. Win's VPN does not sell personal or sensitive user data.
en.User data is used to activate accounts,: User data is used to activate accounts, enforce the three-device limit, provide free and paid VPN access, operate split tunneling, process payments and donations, send account/service emails, document legal acceptance, detect abuse or attacks, answer support requests, improve reliability, and comply with lawful obligations. Data may be shared only with service providers that support those purposes, such as PayPal for payment processing, SMTP2GO for transactional email, Google Play or other app stores for store review and platform services, hosting/CDN/security providers for infrastructure and attack defense, and legal or governmental authorities only when required by valid legal process. Win's VPN does not share VPN browsing history, DNS query history, traffic contents, or destination activity because it is not designed to collect those records.
en.App-to-service and website communication: App-to-service and website communications use encrypted transport where supported, VPN traffic is encrypted from the device to the tunnel endpoint, production secrets are stored outside public source in root-owned server configuration, and operational identifiers are hashed or bucketed where practical. Access to production systems is limited to authorized administrators, and backups/security logs are protected by server access controls. App-collected operational data that is no longer needed for active service operation is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. Account, payment, referral, and legal acceptance records are retained only while needed to operate the account, satisfy accounting/legal obligations, prevent fraud or abuse, resolve disputes, or document customer acceptance. Users may request account deletion or privacy help by contacting privacy@winsvpn.org or support@winsvpn.org; some records may be retained longer only where required for payment, legal, security, fraud-prevention, or dispute-resolution reasons.
en.On Android, Win's VPN uses Android VpnSe: On Android, Win's VPN uses Android VpnService as a core user-facing VPN function. After the user starts a connection and approves Android's standard VPN permission prompt, VpnService creates an encrypted device-level tunnel to a Win's VPN endpoint, routes selected device traffic through that tunnel, supports user-selected split-tunneling exclusions, and shows the Android VPN indicator/notification while active. Win's VPN does not use VpnService to inject ads, monetize traffic, manipulate advertising, sell traffic data, or collect browsing history, DNS query history, traffic contents, or destination activity.

en.We use customized local AI for your priv: We use customized local AI for your privacy, and we keep the VPN current with real-world censorship and network conditions so it keeps working for you. We do not collect your personal data, so we cannot train on it.
en.The first non-profit VPN built on its ow: The first non-profit VPN built on its own protocol. A US 501(c)(3) public charity, expanding access to cybersecurity, uncensored news, and education.
en.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
en.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.
en.Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC mainta: Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC maintain insurance-readiness controls and may seek cyber or Technology Errors and Omissions coverage. We do not represent that a particular policy is currently bound or in force. Coverage must be confirmed from a current binder or issued policy.
en.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
en.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
en.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
en.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
en.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
en.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
en.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
en.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
en.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
en.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
en.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

Antes de a VPN se conectar, o aplicativo pode recuperar uma localização aproximada de IP público e solicitar um mapa circundante do Apple Maps em plataformas Apple ou um serviço de blocos derivado do OpenStreetMap em outras plataformas. O provedor do mapa necessariamente recebe a região do mapa solicitada e o IP de conexão utilizado para essa solicitação; Win's VPN não solicita GPS do dispositivo para este recurso nem retém o IP, cidade, código postal ou histórico de visualização de mapa retornado. Win's VPN não vende dados pessoais ou confidenciais do usuário.
pt.leaves the inventory untouched and the V: deixa o inventário intacto e a VPN permanece utilizável sem exclusões por aplicativo. O inventário de aplicativos instalados é usado localmente para que o usuário possa pesquisar e selecionar aplicativos a serem excluídos da VPN. O inventário completo não é carregado no Win's VPN, compartilhado com terceiros, vendido ou usado para publicidade ou análise. Somente os identificadores de pacote selecionados pelo usuário são retidos nas configurações locais do aplicativo e transmitidos localmente ao Android VpnService para aplicar essas exclusões. O usuário pode remover seleções no seletor de tunelamento dividido ou excluir todas as seleções retidas localmente limpando os dados do aplicativo Win's VPN ou desinstalando o aplicativo.
pt.Amazon gift card checkout is not automat: A finalização da compra do cartão-presente da Amazon ainda não é automatizada. Use o PayPal para ativação instantânea ou entre em contato com support@winsvpn.org antes de enviar qualquer código de cartão-presente.
pt.In the memory of 9/11 victims, we are gi: Em memória das vítimas do 11 de setembro, estamos oferecendo nossos servidores VPN premium gratuitamente até 11 de outubro de 2026.
pt.We use customized local AI for your priv: Usamos IA local personalizada para a sua privacidade e mantemos a VPN atualizada com a censura e as condições de rede do mundo real para que ela continue funcionando para você. Não coletamos seus dados pessoais, portanto não podemos treinar com eles.
pt.The first non-profit VPN built on its ow: A primeira VPN sem fins lucrativos construída sobre seu próprio protocolo. Uma instituição de caridade pública 501(c)(3) dos EUA que amplia o acesso à segurança cibernética, a notícias sem censura e à educação.
pt.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: Nenhum histórico de navegação, nenhum histórico de consultas DNS, nenhum conteúdo de tráfego e nenhum registro dos destinos que você acessa. O estado transitório da sessão é apagado quando a VPN se desconecta. Os metadados de limite de dispositivos, que preservam a privacidade e sustentam o limite de três dispositivos, são excluídos ou sobrescritos assim que um dispositivo é desativado ou substituído, e os dados operacionais coletados pelo aplicativo de que não precisamos mais são excluídos ou anonimizados em até 90 dias. O que resta é apenas o que uma conta precisa: status, estado de pagamento e de indicação, e a comprovação de que você aceitou os termos.
pt.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Nossos servidores adotam uma abordagem de recuperação de desastres com hot site, usando hardware de última geração, manutenção e backups semanais e monitoramento de ataques 24 horas por dia, 7 dias por semana, por um Sistema de Detecção e Prevenção de Intrusões (IDS/IPS). Em cada nó, o firewall descarta por padrão o tráfego de entrada e encaminhado, o IPv6 é desativado, as portas de torrent são bloqueadas e o SSH aceita apenas logins baseados em chave, sem senhas e com bloqueio de 24 horas após 10 tentativas de login malsucedidas em uma hora. As atualizações de segurança são instaladas automaticamente e os core dumps são desativados, de modo que a memória dos processos nunca chega ao disco.
pt.Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC mainta: A Win's VPN Inc. e a Win Empire LLC mantêm controles de preparação para seguros e podem buscar cobertura de riscos cibernéticos ou de Erros e Omissões de Tecnologia. Não declaramos que uma apólice específica esteja atualmente contratada ou em vigor. A cobertura deve ser confirmada por meio de uma nota de cobertura provisória vigente ou de uma apólice emitida.
pt.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: Em termos de telecomunicações, se os principais protocolos VPN atuais são o 5G, o Winn Protocol® foi criado para ser o 6G: uma geração à frente na forma como oculta o tráfego, coloca rotas para competir entre si e mantém a conexão estável em redes hostis.
pt.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: O Winn Protocol® foi projetado para contornar a Inspeção Profunda de Pacotes (DPI) de NGFW, desde que exista um caminho funcional do país do usuário para o mundo exterior.
pt.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Baseado em padrões publicados do NIST e da IETF, não em criptografia privada. Cada primitiva abaixo é especificada publicamente e pode ser revisada de forma independente.
pt.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Híbrida, nunca apenas ML-KEM. Protege o tráfego atual contra a futura descriptografia quântica de sessões gravadas.
pt.Every control-plane request and response: Cada solicitação e resposta do plano de controle é assinada, além da autenticação mútua X.509.
pt.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: O ECH da RFC 9849 oculta o nome de destino. Não é oferecido nenhum fallback apenas clássico ou com ClientHello público.
pt.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Cada dispositivo possui uma identidade URI autenticada que deve corresponder à sua solicitação, com rotação de chaves e sem tempo de inatividade.
pt.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Qualquer divergência em ECH, versão, grupo de cifras ou ALPN interrompe a conexão em vez de rebaixá-la silenciosamente.
pt.Session resumption is disabled, so each: A retomada de sessão está desativada, portanto cada renovação de chaves realiza uma troca pós-quântica híbrida completa.
pt.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
pt.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

zh-CN.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
zh-CN.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.

zh-CN.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
zh-CN.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
zh-CN.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
zh-CN.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
zh-CN.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
zh-CN.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
zh-CN.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
zh-CN.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
zh-CN.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
zh-CN.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
zh-CN.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

zh-TW.We use customized local AI for your priv: We use customized local AI for your privacy, and we keep the VPN current with real-world censorship and network conditions so it keeps working for you. We do not collect your personal data, so we cannot train on it.
zh-TW.The first non-profit VPN built on its ow: The first non-profit VPN built on its own protocol. A US 501(c)(3) public charity, expanding access to cybersecurity, uncensored news, and education.
zh-TW.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
zh-TW.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.
zh-TW.Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC mainta: Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC maintain insurance-readiness controls and may seek cyber or Technology Errors and Omissions coverage. We do not represent that a particular policy is currently bound or in force. Coverage must be confirmed from a current binder or issued policy.
zh-TW.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
zh-TW.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
zh-TW.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
zh-TW.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
zh-TW.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
zh-TW.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
zh-TW.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
zh-TW.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
zh-TW.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
zh-TW.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
zh-TW.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.
zh-TW.Donations from the public and cost-recov: Donations from the public and cost-recovery subscriptions. Contributions are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law. The IRS determination letter and our EIN are published in Proof.

The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. hi.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.

bn.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
bn.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.

bn.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
bn.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
bn.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
bn.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
bn.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
bn.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
bn.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
bn.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
bn.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
bn.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
bn.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

ja.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
ja.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.

ja.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
ja.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
ja.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
ja.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
ja.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
ja.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
ja.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
ja.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
ja.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
ja.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
ja.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

ko.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.

ko.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.

ko.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
ko.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
ko.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
ko.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
ko.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
ko.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
ko.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
ko.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. id.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. id.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.

id.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
id.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
id.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
id.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
id.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
id.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
id.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
id.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
id.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
id.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
id.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

ms.We use customized local AI for your priv: We use customized local AI for your privacy, and we keep the VPN current with real-world censorship and network conditions so it keeps working for you. We do not collect your personal data, so we cannot train on it.
ms.The first non-profit VPN built on its ow: The first non-profit VPN built on its own protocol. A US 501(c)(3) public charity, expanding access to cybersecurity, uncensored news, and education.
ms.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
ms.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.
ms.Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC mainta: Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC maintain insurance-readiness controls and may seek cyber or Technology Errors and Omissions coverage. We do not represent that a particular policy is currently bound or in force. Coverage must be confirmed from a current binder or issued policy.
ms.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
ms.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
ms.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
ms.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
ms.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
ms.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
ms.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
ms.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
ms.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
ms.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
ms.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

th.We use customized local AI for your priv: We use customized local AI for your privacy, and we keep the VPN current with real-world censorship and network conditions so it keeps working for you. We do not collect your personal data, so we cannot train on it.
th.The first non-profit VPN built on its ow: The first non-profit VPN built on its own protocol. A US 501(c)(3) public charity, expanding access to cybersecurity, uncensored news, and education.
th.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
th.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.
th.Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC mainta: Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC maintain insurance-readiness controls and may seek cyber or Technology Errors and Omissions coverage. We do not represent that a particular policy is currently bound or in force. Coverage must be confirmed from a current binder or issued policy.
th.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
th.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
th.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
th.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
th.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
th.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
th.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
th.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
th.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
th.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
th.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

tr.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
tr.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.

We do not represent that a particular policy is currently bound or in force. Coverage must be confirmed from a current binder or issued policy.
tr.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
tr.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
tr.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
tr.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
tr.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
tr.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
tr.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
tr.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
tr.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
tr.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
tr.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

fa.We use customized local AI for your priv: We use customized local AI for your privacy, and we keep the VPN current with real-world censorship and network conditions so it keeps working for you. We do not collect your personal data, so we cannot train on it.
fa.The first non-profit VPN built on its ow: The first non-profit VPN built on its own protocol. A US 501(c)(3) public charity, expanding access to cybersecurity, uncensored news, and education.
fa.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
fa.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.
fa.Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC mainta: Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC maintain insurance-readiness controls and may seek cyber or Technology Errors and Omissions coverage. fa.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
fa.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
fa.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
fa.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
fa.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
fa.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
fa.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
fa.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
fa.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
fa.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
fa.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

ur.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
ur.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.

ur.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
ur.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
ur.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
ur.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
ur.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
ur.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
ur.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
ur.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
ur.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
ur.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
ur.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

ro.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
ro.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
ro.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
ro.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
ro.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
ro.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
ro.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
ro.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
ro.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
ro.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

el.User data is used to activate accounts,: Τα δεδομένα χρήστη χρησιμοποιούνται για την ενεργοποίηση λογαριασμών, την επιβολή του ορίου τριών συσκευών, την παροχή δωρεάν και επί πληρωμή πρόσβαση VPN, τη λειτουργία διαχωρισμού σήραγγας, την επεξεργασία πληρωμών και δωρεών, την αποστολή email λογαριασμού/υπηρεσίας, την τεκμηρίωση νομικής αποδοχής, τον εντοπισμό καταχρήσεων ή επιθέσεων, την απάντηση αιτημάτων υποστήριξης, τη βελτίωση της αξιοπιστίας και τη συμμόρφωση με νόμιμες υποχρεώσεις. Τα δεδομένα μπορούν να κοινοποιηθούν μόνο σε παρόχους υπηρεσιών που υποστηρίζουν αυτούς τους σκοπούς, όπως PayPal για επεξεργασία πληρωμών, SMTP2GO για συναλλαγές ηλεκτρονικού ταχυδρομείου, Google Play ή άλλα καταστήματα εφαρμογών για έλεγχο καταστημάτων και υπηρεσίες πλατφόρμας, παρόχους φιλοξενίας/CDN/ασφάλειας για υποδομές και άμυνα επιθέσεων και νομικές ή κυβερνητικές αρχές μόνο όταν απαιτείται από έγκυρη νομική διαδικασία. Το Win's VPN δεν μοιράζεται το ιστορικό περιήγησης VPN, το ιστορικό ερωτημάτων DNS, το περιεχόμενο επισκεψιμότητας ή τη δραστηριότητα προορισμού, επειδή δεν έχει σχεδιαστεί για τη συλλογή αυτών των εγγραφών.
el.App-to-service and website communication: Οι επικοινωνίες εφαρμογής σε υπηρεσία και ιστότοπου χρησιμοποιούν κρυπτογραφημένη μεταφορά όπου υποστηρίζεται, η κίνηση VPN κρυπτογραφείται από τη συσκευή στο τελικό σημείο της σήραγγας, τα μυστικά παραγωγής αποθηκεύονται εκτός δημόσιας πηγής σε διαμόρφωση διακομιστή που ανήκει στον root και τα λειτουργικά αναγνωριστικά κατακερματίζονται ή τοποθετούνται σε κάδο όπου είναι πρακτικό. Η πρόσβαση στα συστήματα παραγωγής περιορίζεται σε εξουσιοδοτημένους διαχειριστές και τα αντίγραφα ασφαλείας/τα αρχεία καταγραφής ασφαλείας προστατεύονται από ελέγχους πρόσβασης διακομιστή. Τα αρχεία λογαριασμού, πληρωμής, παραπομπής και νόμιμης αποδοχής διατηρούνται μόνο όταν χρειάζονται για τη λειτουργία του λογαριασμού, την εκπλήρωση λογιστικών/νομικών υποχρεώσεων, την αποτροπή απάτης ή κατάχρησης, την επίλυση διαφορών ή την τεκμηρίωση της αποδοχής του πελάτη. Οι χρήστες μπορούν να ζητήσουν βοήθεια για τη διαγραφή λογαριασμού ή το απόρρητο επικοινωνώντας με το privacy@winsvpn.org ή το support@winsvpn.org. Ορισμένα αρχεία μπορούν να διατηρηθούν περισσότερο μόνο όταν απαιτείται για λόγους πληρωμής, νομικούς, ασφάλειας, αποτροπής απάτης ή επίλυσης διαφορών.
el.On Android, Win's VPN uses Android VpnSe: Στο Android, το Win's VPN χρησιμοποιεί Android VpnService ως βασική λειτουργία VPN που αντιμετωπίζει ο χρήστης. Το Win's VPN δεν χρησιμοποιεί το VpnService για την εισαγωγή διαφημίσεων, τη δημιουργία εσόδων από την επισκεψιμότητα, τη χειραγώγηση διαφημίσεων, την πώληση δεδομένων επισκεψιμότητας ή τη συλλογή ιστορικού περιήγησης, ιστορικού ερωτημάτων DNS, περιεχομένου επισκεψιμότητας ή δραστηριότητας προορισμού.

el.We use customized local AI for your priv: We use customized local AI for your privacy, and we keep the VPN current with real-world censorship and network conditions so it keeps working for you. We do not collect your personal data, so we cannot train on it.
el.The first non-profit VPN built on its ow: The first non-profit VPN built on its own protocol. A US 501(c)(3) public charity, expanding access to cybersecurity, uncensored news, and education.
el.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
el.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.
el.Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC mainta: Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC maintain insurance-readiness controls and may seek cyber or Technology Errors and Omissions coverage. We do not represent that a particular policy is currently bound or in force. Coverage must be confirmed from a current binder or issued policy.
el.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
el.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
el.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
el.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
el.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
el.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
el.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
el.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
el.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
el.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
el.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

iw.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. iw.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.

iw.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
iw.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
iw.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
iw.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
iw.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
iw.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
iw.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
iw.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
iw.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
iw.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
iw.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.

no.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
no.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.

no.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.

no.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.

no.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
no.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
no.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
no.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

fi.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. fi.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.

fi.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
fi.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
fi.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
fi.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
fi.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
fi.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
fi.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
fi.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
fi.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
fi.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
fi.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

cs.App-to-service and website communication: Komunikace mezi aplikacemi a webovými stránkami využívá šifrovaný přenos tam, kde je to podporováno, provoz VPN je šifrován ze zařízení do koncového bodu tunelu, produkční tajemství jsou uložena mimo veřejný zdroj v konfiguraci serveru vlastněného rootem a provozní identifikátory jsou hašovány nebo bucketovány tam, kde je to praktické. cs.leaves the inventory untouched and the V: ponechá inventář nedotčený a VPN zůstane použitelná bez výjimek pro jednotlivé aplikace. cs.We use customized local AI for your priv: We use customized local AI for your privacy, and we keep the VPN current with real-world censorship and network conditions so it keeps working for you. We do not collect your personal data, so we cannot train on it.
cs.The first non-profit VPN built on its ow: The first non-profit VPN built on its own protocol. A US 501(c)(3) public charity, expanding access to cybersecurity, uncensored news, and education.
cs.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
cs.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.
cs.Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC mainta: Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC maintain insurance-readiness controls and may seek cyber or Technology Errors and Omissions coverage. We do not represent that a particular policy is currently bound or in force. Coverage must be confirmed from a current binder or issued policy.
cs.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
cs.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
cs.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
cs.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
cs.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
cs.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
cs.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
cs.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
cs.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
cs.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
cs.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.
cs.Donations from the public and cost-recov: Donations from the public and cost-recovery subscriptions. Contributions are tax-deductible to the extent allowed by law. The IRS determination letter and our EIN are published in Proof.

sw.We use customized local AI for your priv: We use customized local AI for your privacy, and we keep the VPN current with real-world censorship and network conditions so it keeps working for you. We do not collect your personal data, so we cannot train on it.
sw.The first non-profit VPN built on its ow: The first non-profit VPN built on its own protocol. A US 501(c)(3) public charity, expanding access to cybersecurity, uncensored news, and education.
sw.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
sw.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.
sw.Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC mainta: Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC maintain insurance-readiness controls and may seek cyber or Technology Errors and Omissions coverage. We do not represent that a particular policy is currently bound or in force. Coverage must be confirmed from a current binder or issued policy.
sw.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
sw.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
sw.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
sw.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
sw.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
sw.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
sw.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
sw.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
sw.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
sw.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
sw.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.
