am.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
am.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.

tl.We use customized local AI for your priv: We use customized local AI for your privacy, and we keep the VPN current with real-world censorship and network conditions so it keeps working for you. We do not collect your personal data, so we cannot train on it.
tl.The first non-profit VPN built on its ow: The first non-profit VPN built on its own protocol. A US 501(c)(3) public charity, expanding access to cybersecurity, uncensored news, and education.
tl.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
tl.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.
tl.Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC mainta: Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC maintain insurance-readiness controls and may seek cyber or Technology Errors and Omissions coverage. We do not represent that a particular policy is currently bound or in force. Coverage must be confirmed from a current binder or issued policy.
tl.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
tl.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
tl.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
tl.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
tl.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
tl.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
tl.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
tl.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
tl.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
tl.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
tl.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

km.We use customized local AI for your priv: We use customized local AI for your privacy, and we keep the VPN current with real-world censorship and network conditions so it keeps working for you. We do not collect your personal data, so we cannot train on it.
km.The first non-profit VPN built on its ow: The first non-profit VPN built on its own protocol. A US 501(c)(3) public charity, expanding access to cybersecurity, uncensored news, and education.
km.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
km.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.
km.Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC mainta: Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC maintain insurance-readiness controls and may seek cyber or Technology Errors and Omissions coverage. We do not represent that a particular policy is currently bound or in force. Coverage must be confirmed from a current binder or issued policy.
km.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
km.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
km.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
km.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
km.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
km.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
km.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
km.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
km.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
km.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
km.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.

lo.We use customized local AI for your priv: We use customized local AI for your privacy, and we keep the VPN current with real-world censorship and network conditions so it keeps working for you. We do not collect your personal data, so we cannot train on it.
lo.The first non-profit VPN built on its ow: The first non-profit VPN built on its own protocol. A US 501(c)(3) public charity, expanding access to cybersecurity, uncensored news, and education.
lo.No browsing history, no DNS query histor: No browsing history, no DNS query history, no traffic contents, and no record of the destinations you reach. Transient session state is cleared when the VPN disconnects. The privacy-preserving device-limit metadata behind the three-device limit is deleted or overwritten once a device is deactivated or replaced, and app-collected operational data we no longer need is deleted or anonymized within 90 days. What is left is only what an account needs: status, payment and referral state, and proof you accepted the terms.
lo.Our servers have a hot site disaster rec: Our servers have a hot site disaster recovery approach using latest hardware, weekly maintenance and backups, and 24/7 attack monitoring by Intrusion Detection & Prevention System (IDS/IPS). On every node the firewall drops inbound and forwarded traffic by default, IPv6 is disabled, torrent ports are blocked, and SSH accepts key-based logins only, with no passwords and a 24-hour ban after 10 failed logins in an hour. Security updates install automatically and core dumps are disabled, so process memory never reaches disk.
lo.Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC mainta: Win's VPN Inc. and Win Empire LLC maintain insurance-readiness controls and may seek cyber or Technology Errors and Omissions coverage. We do not represent that a particular policy is currently bound or in force. Coverage must be confirmed from a current binder or issued policy.
lo.In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN: In telecom terms, if today’s leading VPN protocols are 5G, Winn Protocol® is built to be the 6G: a generation ahead in how it hides traffic, races routes, and holds a connection together across hostile networks.
lo.Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass N: Winn Protocol® is engineered to bypass NGFW Deep Packet Inspection as long as there is a working path from a user’s country to the outside world.
lo.Built on published NIST and IETF standar: Built on published NIST and IETF standards, not private cryptography. Every primitive below is publicly specified and independently reviewable.
lo.Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects tod: Hybrid, never ML-KEM alone. Protects today’s traffic against future quantum decryption of recorded sessions.
lo.Every control-plane request and response: Every control-plane request and response is signed, in addition to mutual X.509 authentication.
lo.RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination na: RFC 9849 ECH conceals the destination name. No classical-only or public-ClientHello fallback is offered.
lo.Each device carries an authenticated URI: Each device carries an authenticated URI identity that must match its request, with key rotation and no downtime.
lo.Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher gro: Any mismatch in ECH, version, cipher group or ALPN aborts the connection rather than silently downgrading it.
lo.Session resumption is disabled, so each: Session resumption is disabled, so each rekey performs a full hybrid post-quantum exchange.
lo.Our adaptable, modified, and hardened ve: Our adaptable, modified, and hardened versions of proven censorship-bypassing protocols are designed to bypass censorship without affecting speed.
lo.Winn Protocol® prepares several routes i: Winn Protocol® prepares several routes in advance and races them. If a path degrades or drops, a replacement is established and verified before the old one is torn down (make-before-break) so the tunnel does not go down while it changes. The kill switch stays active throughout, so traffic never escapes during the handover.
